observations.code_quote: Duckgres stores a table-naming version on the organization. Organizations that existed when versioning was introduced keep the batch sink's snake-case format, such as `tik_tok_ads_ad_report`. New organizations use the copy workflow format, such as `tiktokads_ad_report`. Copy, registration, the batch sink, and query binding derive the same physical name from that organization-level policy. Do not change the policy after an organization has written data unless the underlying tables are migrated at the same time.

observations.behavior: Adds a new field to the cached row used by warehouse ingestion, storing the naming version.
observations.posthog_connection: This field is read by warehouse ingestion to choose the naming convention; without it, the warehouse connector cannot distinguish copy_v1 from legacy_batch_v1.

observations.behavior: Adds tests for warehouse ingestion, including a new class and two test cases, checking that the naming version is resolved from the cached row and defaults to copy_v1 when no cached row exists.
observations.posthog_connection: These tests establish that warehouse ingestion correctly chooses the naming convention and rejects unknown versions.

observations.behavior: Adds a new module, duckgres_naming.py, with a function to generate Duckgres-compatible table names based on the naming version, including a new copy_v1 path and a legacy_batch_v1 path.
observations.posthog_connection: This module provides the warehouse ingestion connector with a way to generate table names compatible with Duckgres, including a new copy_v1 path and a legacy_batch_v1 path.
